verdict.rationale: mParticle's marketing site claims an in-product assistant where you describe an audience, journey, or growth goal and it 'understands the customer data behind it' and 'suggests the logic to use'. It also claims predictive scoring for churn, conversion, and value, plus audience expansion based on customer behaviors. These are only one-line homepage claims, with no product docs or hands-on corroboration of how the suggestions or insights work. missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the AI suggestion feature, evidence of broader AI-generated insights beyond audience logic and scores, independent or hands-on corroboration.
